meta.title: The PR line shows Ordered after the award's PO is created

plan.title: PR line shows ordered after PO creation

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area where the relevant PR can be found.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab as required by the case.

args.goal: Search for the PR number used by the awarded PR-based event, open its line details, and verify that the line shows Completed or the ordered quantity and that the generated PO number is linked.

steps.note: Perform the PR-number search and line-detail inspection, including the conditional completion or ordered-quantity and PO-link assertions not covered by a dedicated PR step.
Confirm the PR screen remains rendered after inspecting the line details.
